text: Two secret words, used one after the other on the table, add up: each place uses one slot of the 7-letter word and one of the 8-letter word, and each known letter forces their total.
Places that share a slot tie the other slots together; when a chain of ties comes back to a slot, the totals must agree. For lengths 7 and 8 they first disagree at place 64.
Every pair of lengths from 2 to 30 was tried, plain and carved alphabets standard or the sculpture's: no pair with total length below 25 survives, and no survivor is made of puzzle words.
